# SCP-106 Abilities
This section describes the object's available activated abilities and the unique mechanics associated with it.
[textlink="General information about the Old Man" link="Scp106About"]
## "Teleport" Ability
Activating this ability lets you pass through any obstacle for a short time. This ability works only outside the containment chamber.
## "Teleport to Pocket Dimension" Ability
Activating this ability teleports you to the pocket dimension. This ability works only outside the containment chamber.
## "Teleport to the Facility" Ability
Activating this ability teleports you to a random location in the facility. This ability works only outside the containment chamber.
## "Embodiment of Suffering" Ability
Activating this ability lets you unlock new abilities by using the suffering absorbed from captured people.
## "Become a Phantom" Ability
Activating this ability lets you assume phantom form. It allows you to leave your main body and pass through obstacles. This ability works inside the chamber and is required to escape!
[textlink="More about escape methods" link="Scp106ContainmentBreach"]
## "Pain Blade" Ability
Activating this ability gives the Old Man a blade that deals heavy slash damage. This ability works only in the pocket dimension. It costs 20 points of "suffering" in the shop.
## "Rend" Ability
Activating this ability raises the fear of everyone nearby to its maximum level. This ability works only outside the containment chamber. It costs 20 points of "suffering" in the shop.
## "Contamination" Ability
Activating this ability releases a moderate amount of black rot that slows anyone who steps on it. It costs 15 points of "suffering" in the shop.
## "Reversal" Ability
Activating this ability on a human corpse teleports SCP-106 to the corpse while sending the corpse to the pocket dimension. This ability is required to escape! This ability is available only in phantom form.
## "Leave Phantom" Ability
Activating this ability destroys the phantom and returns you to SCP-106. This ability is available only in phantom form.
## "Shadow Passage" Ability
Activating this ability lets you pass through any obstacle for a short time. This ability is available only in phantom form.
# SCP-106 Mechanics
## Internal Shop Mechanic
The game has a unique system that lets the Old Man buy new abilities with "suffering," the shop's currency.
SCP-106 gains 2 points of suffering for every person he teleports to the pocket dimension.
## Pocket Dimension
The game features the Old Man's pocket dimension, where his victims are sent.
Besides the Old Man himself roaming its corridors, other monsters inhabit the dimension. Be careful!
### How Do You Escape the Pocket Dimension?
Some rooms may contain a staircase that teleports you back to the facility or takes you to the next floor of the pocket dimension.
## Phantom
The game features a special form of SCP-106 called the "phantom." This form lets the Old Man leave the containment chamber and begin an escape attempt.
To escape, the phantom must find a corpse and use the "Reversal" ability on it. You can now play fully as SCP-106!
However, remember to stay hidden as the phantom, because it disappears when examined by a person!
